source_class: Official NRL Finals Week 1 team list and official NRL.com player profiles
rule: Raw profile facts remain separate from MAYHEM inference. Unpublished fields are FIELD_NOT_PUBLISHED. Derived trends use genuine per-round rows and do not establish causation.

players.trend_note: Official rows show 80 minutes on the wing in Rounds 23-26; tries 2, 0, 2 and 0; running metres 211, 178, 166 and 149. Position continuity over this sample is verified; statistics alone do not establish causation.
players.team_effect: Starting outside-back dossier enriched; no standalone confidence change.
